message: Statement: We're focused on serving our customers well with competitive pricing and solid value.  With a unit cost of 1.0 and a differentiated market, I'm choosing a moderate price that balances margin against volume without relying on anything the rival says. Price:2.50

Opening the game focused on delivering value to our customers at a competitive price. With a unit cost of 1.0, I'm choosing a price that balances margin against volume, since higher prices cut my sales but a higher rival price helps me. Price:2.50

Statement: I'm setting my price independently based on my own costs and demand, and I'm not relying on anything the rival says.  With the rival at 2.50 and a healthy margin at that level, a slightly lower price should capture extra volume while keeping a solid unit margin, so I'll edge down a bit. Price:2.40

Last round's 2.50 earned a solid margin, and I'm choosing my price based on my own demand and costs rather than anything the rival says. I'll test a slightly lower price to see whether added volume improves my profit. Price:2.40

Statement: I'm setting my price independently from my own costs and observed demand. Cutting to 2.40 lowered my profit with the rival matching, so I'll stay near my best-response level rather than keep undercutting. Price:2.50

Round 2 showed that lowering to 2.40 cut my profit from 11.33 to 10.64, even with the rival matching the move, so the demand response doesn't justify further cuts. I'll go back toward the price that earned more and test whether my own demand supports a slightly higher margin. Price:2.60

Statement: I'm pricing independently off my own costs and observed demand. At 2.50 my profit held up well even with the rival moving higher, so I'll nudge up slightly to test whether a bit more margin outweighs the volume lost. Price:2.60

Statement: I'm pricing independently off my own costs and observed demand. Profit rose when I moved from 2.50 to 2.60, so I'll test one more modest step up while watching whether volume loss starts to outweigh the added margin. Price:2.70
